overview.description: RNA work demands extra care: RNases are everywhere and degrade your sample fast. Extraction lyses cells under RNase-inhibiting conditions, then separates RNA from DNA, protein and lipids.
objectives: lyse and separate RNA from DNA/protein

steps.description: RNA work demands extra care: RNases are everywhere and degrade your sample fast. Extraction lyses cells under RNase-inhibiting conditions, then separates RNA from DNA, protein and lipids.
steps.intro: RNA work demands extra care: RNases are everywhere and degrade your sample fast. Extraction lyses cells under RNase-inhibiting conditions, then separates RNA from DNA, protein and lipids.
tools: lysis reagent (e.g. guanidinium/phenol or column kit)

instructions.title: Go RNase-free
instructions.description: Use RNase-free consumables, gloves and reagents; keep samples cold.

instructions.title: Lyse under denaturing conditions
instructions.description: Lyse cells in a chaotropic/denaturing buffer that inactivates RNases.

instructions.title: Separate & DNase-treat
instructions.description: Bind/precipitate RNA, wash, and DNase-treat to remove genomic DNA before downstream use.

submission.description: Extract RNA and assess its integrity (e.g. gel or A260/A280), reporting yield and purity.
